headline: Data Scientist – Subscription Data Enablement
description_text: Our paywall is a model. Come and make it smarter. Schibsted | Oslo, Bergen or Stockholm (hybrid) We built our own dynamic paywall and offer engine. Now we need to make it better, understand what works, and bring it to more brands. We're looking for a Data Scientist who enjoys building models, testing ideas and finding out whether the results actually make a difference. You'll work alongside experienced data scientists, analysts and engineers, with opportunities to take ownership of your work and grow your skills along the way. Why this work matters Our democracies depend on independent journalism, and that is our business. Independent journalism needs readers who choose to pay for it. Our job in Subscription Data Enablement is to understand those readers well enough to offer them the right thing at the right time, and to leave them alone when we shouldn't bother them. Direct relationships with readers and digital profitability are how Schibsted measures success. Your models sit right in the middle of both. Who we are We are the data and analytics team for Schibsted's Subscription business in Norway and Sweden: analysts, data engineers, an ML engineer and data scientists. We work with brands such as VG, Aftenposten, Aftonbladet, Svenska Dagbladet, Bergens Tidende and E24. Our models already cover churn, renewal, segmentation and engagement. The dynamic paywall and offer engine is the newest addition to the family. It is also a good test of how we work. The Dynamic Paywall project has many moving parts and competing priorities, and it needs people from data, product, tech, business and editorial teams in the same room. A consultant who recently worked with us said that, despite technically being a consultant, they "never really felt like one". They described a team where everyone brings different expertise, ideas get challenged, debates are healthy, and we don't always agree, but there is "always mutual respect" and a shared goal of finding the best way forward. We want you to feel the same way about us a year from now. What you will do Make our paywall smarter. Develop and improve the models behind our dynamic paywall and offers: who sees which offer, and when. Propensity, recommender and offer optimisation problems are all in scope. Find out what works. Design, run and analyse experiments with our brands, and report the results as they are, including what they don’t prove. Uplift modelling and causal inference are welcome tools here. Build models that get used. Take models from notebook to production with our data scientists and engineers: feature engineering, training, evaluation, testing, and monitoring once they’re live. We work with tools such as Snowflake, MLflow and Streamlit. Make the results understandable. Explain findings to commercial colleagues with clear analysis and dashboards where they help. Improve how we work. Bring ideas on modelling, tooling and MLOps as more brands come on board, including how AI can make our own work easier. Ask good questions. Including “does this actually make us money?” when someone needs to. What you bring Python or R and SQL, used to analyse data and build models. Hands-on experience developing and evaluating machine learning models, and an understanding of what it takes to run them in production. A solid foundation in statistics and experimentation, including hypothesis testing and A/B tests. The ability to explain your work to people who don’t speak ML, and the curiosity to learn from people who know the business better than you do. How we work We follow a short list of team principles, and we mean them: be curious and keep learning, deliver quality together, design collaboratively, help early and ask early, share generously, have fun and stay open. In practice, that means Show n Tell and Friday data talks every other week, a monthly hack day, and an expectation that you ask for help before you’re stuck, not after. We also encourage sitting in on newsroom meetings. It’s hard to build a good model of what readers value without knowing what the newsrooms think is important. What you can expect from us Real ML problems, with models that influence decisions across some of the Nordics’ best-known news brands. Experienced colleagues to learn from, and room to take ownership of your work. Time and space to learn, experiment and share ideas. The practical bits Location: Oslo, Bergen or Stockholm. Hybrid. Employee terms and benefits follow Schibsted’s standards in your country, and we are happy to go through the details with you in the process. The team is spread across Norway and Sweden, so some days are on video. Working language: English We welcome applications from people with different experiences and career paths, and we focus on the skills and potential you bring. Apply Send your CV and a few lines about a data science or machine learning project you've worked on. What problem were you trying to solve, what was your contribution, and what did you learn? It doesn't have to be a model you took all the way to production. We're interested in how you think and what you've learned from doing the work. No long cover letter needed. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and let you know the outcome of your application. Deadline: November 6th 2026 Questions? Contact Johanna Haglund Lindqvist, Head of Data Science & Data Engineering. About Schibsted Schibsted is the largest news provider in the Nordics, with brands such as VG, Aftonbladet, TV4, MTV, Aftenposten, Svenska Dagbladet and Podme. Every day we inform, engage and entertain millions of people across Sweden, Norway and Finland. Since 1839, trust has been our foundation.

headline: Lead AI Engineer
description_text: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. The position Imagine being able to improve how an entire company works through AI. As AI Enablement Lead, you will help teams across Cambio identify opportunities, solve real business problems and turn ideas into working AI solutions that save time, improve quality and create measurable business value. You will be part of our virtual AI engineering team; an internal AI acceleration team focused on helping nearly 1,000 colleagues work smarter through practical AI solutions. From building agents and automations to supporting Product Engineers and scaling successful initiatives, you will play a key role in shaping how AI is adopted across Cambio. This is a hands-on builder role. You are expected to create solutions, not just talk about them. What You'll Be Doing Build Prototype and build AI agents, automations, internal applications and workflows. Work directly with users to turn real problems into working solutions. Use Microsoft 365, Copilot and modern AI technologies to rapidly test, iterate and deploy solutions. Create reusable components and patterns that accelerate future development. Drive Own and shape the pipeline of AI opportunities across Cambio. Prioritize initiatives, support Product Engineers and remove blockers. Ensure delivery remains focused on measurable business value. Enable Help teams identify opportunities where AI can improve everyday work. Run workshops, demos and coaching sessions that drive adoption. Capture and share proven patterns, solutions and best practices. Scale Identify solutions with broader potential across Cambio. Partner with the AI Platform Team to turn successful initiatives into scalable capabilities. Feed recurring needs and learnings back into the platform roadmap. How You'll Work You will work in a highly iterative way: Discover → Build → Test → Adopt → Measure → Scale One day you might be building an AI agent with a business team, the next supporting Product Engineers or helping scale a successful solution across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, enablement and operations. About you Builder : You enjoy turning ideas into working solutions and getting them into the hands of users. AI-native : AI is already a core part of how you solve problems and create value. Technically capable : You are comfortable working with code, APIs, automation, agents and modern AI tooling. Business-minded: You care about solving real problems and delivering measurable outcomes. Influential: You can work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and help drive adoption. Technical Experience We believe you have experience in several of the following areas: 5+ years of modern software development. 2+ years of building AI-powered solutions, agents, automations or copilots. Experience with Microsoft technologies such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, Power Platform or Azure AI services. Experience integrating systems through APIs and building workflow automations. Experience using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day software development. Experience taking solutions from prototype to production and adoption. Experience with one or more modern programming languages such as Python, C#, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript Place of employment : Stockholm eller Linköping Scope : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link. We look forward to receiving your application! CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life . Read more about us here! A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible - explore our employee benefits Learn more about our recruitment process here Are you interested in Cambio but you don’t feel that this position is the perfect match? Check out our other open positions at our career site.

headline: CX Development Manager
description_text: Every NOBA customer relationship starts with an application. You will make it count. As CX Development Manager , you will lead the development of our digital customer journeys across our brands and products. Your main focus is the path from started application to onboarded customer, and your scope also includes other digital customer interfaces, such as logged-in customer pages and apps. You are the front door for change. You drive what gets prioritized, make sure it is built right, and work with experimentation and tracking to prove with data that it worked. Why this is a challenge worth taking Digital Experience & Optimization is a new function within the CMO area. Our systematic, data-driven approach has already delivered clear results at Bank Norwegian, and now we are taking it to more brands and products. You will help define how that works in practice, in a regulated environment where every change must be both effective and compliant, and with many stakeholders pulling in different directions. We are also actively exploring how AI and agents can make the way we work more efficient, and you will help put that into practice. You will work side by side with UX/UI, CRO, tracking & measurement and digital governance, and closely with Product Management, Product & Tech, Brand & Communication, Performance Marketing, Customer Engagement & Monetization, and Legal & Compliance. In this role you will report directly to Head of Digital Experience & Optimization, Fredrik Jansson. What you will do Be the front door for change: receive, qualify and prioritize requests from across the business, and keep a transparent backlog and roadmap. Application and onboarding are the main focus, alongside other digital customer interfaces. Align with the business: make sure priorities for the digital customer interfaces fit with the commercial product roadmap and goals. Find and size the opportunities: use data and analytics to see where customers drop off or run into friction, quantify the problem, and build business cases with expected impact. Turn ideas into buildable requirements: write clear, testable requirements with acceptance criteria and measurement points that developers can build from. Lead delivery to proven results: drive initiatives across UX, experimentation, tracking and governance, take part in acceptance testing, and make sure changes are validated through A/B tests and followed up over time, not just at launch. You believe AI and agents can make our work more efficient, and you want to be part of making that happen. You lead with warmth and are not afraid to say no with good reasons. headline: Data Engineer

You'll build and evolve our data platform and help the bank innovate and grow through reliable, accessible data. About the role: The Data & Analytics Engineering department brings together specialists in data infrastructure, analytics, and data management. Together we build a modern and reliable data foundation that supports decision making across the business. This role is in the Data Management & New Initiatives team. You'll design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and data models on Databricks and dbt. You'll work with colleagues across the bank to understand business needs and translate them into well-designed, scalable data solutions. From ingesting new sources to modelling data for analytics and reporting, you'll own the work end to end and see the impact of what you build. We use AI extensively in our daily work, from writing and reviewing code to documentation and analysis. You'll be encouraged to use AI tools to work faster and smarter, and to help us find new ways to apply them. This is a great opportunity to enjoy a high degree of self-responsibility and to expand your expertise into areas of your interest. You'll collaborate broadly and see the tangible results of your work. We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team building, and enjoying fikas and after work gatherings together! Main tasks: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines using Databricks and dbt Develop and maintain data models that make data easy to understand and use for analytics and reporting Integrate new data sources and transform data from ingestion through to consumption. Optimize pipeline performance, scalability, and cost Apply version control and CI/CD practices to deploy changes safely and efficiently Use AI tools to speed up development, testing, and documentation, while applying sound judgment on quality and security Collaborate with analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver data that meets real needs Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the data lifecycle Document solutions and contribute to best practices We are looking for you who: Enjoys building well-structured, reliable data solutions and is curious about new technologies and modern data engineering practices. You like understanding the "why" behind a business need and turning it into something practical and scalable. You're proactive and detail-oriented, you thrive in collaborative environments, and you approach challenges with a "can-do" mindset. You value a high degree of self-responsibility and are motivated to grow in the areas that interest you. You're open to using AI as part of how you work and stay curious about how it changes modern data engineering. For this role, you'll need: Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role Fluency in English, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian An academic degree in a relevant field such as data engineering, computer science, or a related discipline Practical experience with both Databricks and dbt in a production environment Strong proficiency in SQL and in ETL/ELT processes, with a solid understanding of how data is sourced, transformed, and delivered to end users Experience with data modelling (e.g., dimensional modelling, medallion architectures) Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure's data stack Solid understanding of version control systems and CI/CD tools It's positive if you: Python experience Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and a pragmatic, curious approach to using them in your work Previous experience in data-focused roles within the financial sector Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code Our offer to you Freedom with responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style and a high degree of self-responsibility Career development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role, and to expand your expertise into areas of your interest Feedback culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication Coaching leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey A caring company culture: We genuinely care about each other! headline: Credit Risk Analyst
description_text: Every great credit decision starts with a question: can we trust this number? Our Credit Analytics team spends its days answering it, and we're looking for a Credit Risk Analyst to help us do it even better. Get an idea of the role Picture your first few weeks. You sit down with a scorecard that's been running in production for a while, and together with a colleague you start asking how it's really performing. Is it still ranking customers well? Has the portfolio shifted underneath it? You dig in, find the answer, and then comes the part we care about most: turning that analysis into something a colleague or stakeholder can read, understand, and act on. That's the rhythm of the work. You'll develop, validate, and monitor credit scorecards, and you'll explain what they tell us in plain, clear language. Along the way, you'll help us improve how we work: documenting and structuring our code, sharing analyses properly, and using version control and reproducible workflows so that nothing lives only on one person's laptop. Because good teams never stand still, you'll also get to explore new methods and tools and test them honestly against the approach we use today. Requirements for the role You've spent a few years in credit risk, analytics, or a similar quantitative role, and you're comfortable in Python and SQL. If you also know SAS, that's a welcome bonus. Your background might be a degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, data science, or a related field, or it might be an experience that taught you the same things. More than any single skill, we're looking for curiosity, and a habit of explaining your work so that others can follow it. If you've used Git and code review, or you know your way around model validation and documentation requirements, you'll feel at home quickly. If not, you'll learn. What it's like to work here You'll be joining a team of four senior analysts, led by Dácil Hernández, who genuinely enjoy sharing what they know. Mentoring isn't an afterthought here; colleagues invest real time in it. You won't be expected to know everything on day one. Questions are welcome, and from early on you'll have real ownership of your work. The challenges are varied too, with credit risk questions spanning multiple Nordic markets. Resurs in brief At Resurs, we make everyday finances easier through innovative and customer-focused solutions. With customers across the Nordics and more than 800 colleagues, we are committed to creating long-term value for individuals, businesses, and society. Recognized as a career company for the past six years, we put strong emphasis on both personal and professional growth. We want to make a difference by striving to be our best, acting with kindness, and building trust through clarity and collaboration. Our heart beats strong and it shows in everything we do. Although we are based in the Nordics, our team is enriched by the breadth of perspectives brought by colleagues from different countries. We foster a welcoming and supportive culture, where collaboration drives us to achieve the best outcomes for our users. Apply today! Don’t wait to send in your application. Selection and interviews take place on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the last application date. We look forward to hearing from you! Important information On final candidates, we carry out a detailed background check via an external company. #LI-LN1

headline: Senior Data Lead - Product
description_text: About the position Schibsted Media builds news products that more than 6 million people across the Nordics use every day. Data is at the heart of building products that people love, and we are building a modern data foundation that supports smarter personalization, user engagement, and monetization across our media brands. We are now hiring a Senior Data Lead to join us. This is a new role, created as our data teams have grown and matured. We now want to take the next step towards a shared way of working, with common standards and best practice that hold across domains, disciplines and brands, and we are looking for someone to lead that work. As Senior Data Lead you work directly alongside our Director of Data, with wide influence across analytics, data engineering and data science. Our Product Data teams span three domains. User covers the user lifecycle, Content covers the lifecycle of the news content we produce, and Performance works directly with our media brands. Your role spans all three, setting shared direction and standards that help teams stay aligned and move faster with data. What you will do You will be accountable for Product Data as a discipline, and lead the cross-product data initiatives that no single domain can own. Set the direction. Together with the Director of Data, define technical and analytical direction across our data domains, and be a point of reference for analysts, data engineers and data scientists. Shape how we work. Build our operating model and one shared playbook of standards, guidelines and reusable patterns, covering how data products are owned, documented and kept reliable. You do this together with lead analysts, engineers and product owners, who each drive a practice area such as metrics and KPIs, data products, engineering or experimentation. Lead cross-product initiatives. Lead a small number of data initiatives that span several domains and brands, such as shared KPIs and user segments across our products. Improve how we build with AI. Explore and scale new ways of using AI across data work, from better tools for analysts and engineers to agents, and set the quality bar for AI-produced analysis. Make sure our data is ready to power AI product features. Partner with Schibsted's central Data teams. Work closely with our central Data and AI teams on governance, data architecture and shared standards. Bring in Product's needs and expectations, and turn shared decisions into how we work in Product. Grow senior people. Coach and develop senior and lead individual contributors across all three disciplines, without line management. What we're looking for: You bring deep expertise in at least one of analytics, data engineering or data science, and enough fluency in the others to be credible across all three. We don't expect anyone to be an expert in everything below. At the core, you have 7+ years of experience in analytics, data engineering or data science, including several years in senior or lead roles with influence across teams. Experience building shared ways of working, standards and best practice across several teams. Experience designing metrics and KPIs that hold across brands, products or markets. Strong SQL and data modelling skills, with hands-on experience of dbt and a cloud warehouse such as Snowflake. Strong skills in Python or R. Applied experience using AI and LLM tooling in analytical or engineering work. Clear technical writing, ideally with experience of architecture decision records (ADRs). Strong judgement about scope and priorities. You can decline or redirect work, including valuable work, so that the most important things get done. Depth in some of these is a strong plus Data mesh and data product practice, such as domain ownership, data contracts, service levels and documentation. Data governance, data quality and privacy under GDPR. Experiment design and causal inference, including quasi-experimental methods and holdouts. ML and AI methods, deep enough to set quality and evaluation standards for others' work. It's also a plus if you have Fluent Swedish or Norwegian. You will work closely with editorial and brand stakeholders in both markets. Experience from media, or from translating data work for executive and board-level audiences. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and identities to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. What matters most is your motivation and potential. Our tech stack: Data platform: AWS, Snowflake Transformation and orchestration: dbt, Airflow Programming and scripting: Python, SQL, R Exploration and delivery: Amplitude, Superset, Streamlit, Kilkaya Tracking and events: Pulse (in-house tracking), Kafka Who you are You lead through influence. You build alignment in groups that don't report to you, explain the why behind a standard, and are comfortable holding an outcome while someone else does the work. You write clearly, because much of what you produce has to work without you in the room. And you have good judgement about scope: you make a call, document your reasoning, and say no when something belongs elsewhere. Why we enjoy working here: At Schibsted, we value openness, curiosity, and collaboration. You'll be part of a diverse, inclusive workplace that encourages bold thinking and continuous learning. Our work directly supports public interest journalism, and we take that responsibility seriously. Whether you're enabling better content decisions, driving user personalization, or shaping experimentation at scale, your contributions will help shape the future of digital media in the Nordics. You will be joining a collaborative, impact-driven team that works across disciplines like technology, product, and editorial. We believe in structured yet flexible ways of working, balancing clear ownership with strong teamwork. Curiosity, openness, and a drive to create value through data are at the heart of how we operate. We support each other, celebrate continuous learning, and are passionate about turning complex challenges into meaningful solutions for our users and brands. Application process: Please apply for this position by sharing your CV with us and a letter of motivation. English is our corporate language, but you are welcome to write it in Swedish or Norwegian. Selection of candidates takes place on an ongoing basis during the process.

headline: System Specialist - Core Banking
description_text: NOBA is building a new core banking system, and we're looking for the expert who can help us get it right. As System Specialist, you take a key role in this brand-new build, with real ownership and influence over how our financial products work from the inside. Your experience will make a visible impact. The team Projects and Product Development is a driving force for change at NOBA. We optimize processes and system support across the organization, with a long-term view and stable solutions in mind. So far we've built onboarding for mortgages and personal loans. Now we're taking on our first own core system, working side by side with the business and our software engineering team. About the role You will own the requirements for one of the core systems behind NOBA's financial products, sitting between business, legal and development. You turn complex rules, regulations and business needs into clear specifications, and drive them through to implementation, so our solutions are stable and compliant. In your role, you will: Be the driving force in keeping our core solutions for financial products optimized Analyze complex processes, rules and regulations across the customer life cycle, including new regulations such as CCD2 Talk to stakeholders to make sure every aspect is considered when specifying a change Translate business and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable system specifications and the documentation that goes with them Explain complex flows in a way that works for both developers and the business Drive the implementation of changes in the core systems together with development and business teams Make sure our system solutions are stable, compliant and support efficient end-to-end processes Who we're looking for You're an accountable team player who stays calm when things get complex. headline: System Engineer - Infrastructure Automation

headline: Låneförvaltare till Svensk Hypotekspension
description_text: Trivs du med siffror, struktur och att säkerställa hög kvalitet i varje detalj? Som låneförvaltare inom hypotekslån med kapitalfrigöringskredit får du en central roll där du kombinerar analytiskt tänkande med kundfokus. Du ansvarar för att våra lån hanteras korrekt bidrar till en effektiv och tillförlitlig låneförvaltning. Svensk Hypotekspension är specialiserat på hypotekspension - en kapitalfrigöringskredit som låter personer över 60 år att låna med bostaden som säkerhet utan att amortera eller betala ränta löpande. På så vis kan kunden frigöra pengar ur sitt hem utan att sälja och flytta, och utan att vardagsekonomin påverkas. Om rollen: Som låneförvaltare ansvarar du för den löpande förvaltningen och administrationen av in- och utbetalningar, där noggrannhet och ett gott sifferhuvud är avgörande. Din vardag är omväxlande och består av förbereda och genomföra dagliga utbetalningar av beviljade lån med rätt säkerhet på plats, hantera pantbrev och avslut av lån. Du sköter registervård av lånereskontran, gör löpande avstämningar och kontrollerar att siffrorna stämmer. Rollen kombinerar det noggranna sifferarbetet med en god servicekänsla. Du ska motiveras av administrativa arbetsuppgifter. En del av din tid lägger du på att besvara frågor från kunder, mäklare och andra banker via telefon och e-post. Du hanterar allt från transaktioner kopplade till nya kunder till befintliga kunders skulder och lån, och säkerställer att rätt information finns på plats när det krävs. Huvudsakliga uppgifter: Ansvara för den löpande förvaltningen och administrationen av bolån med säkerhet i fastighet eller bostadsrätt. Säkerställa en korrekt och effektiv hantering av låneärenden, från utbetalning till avslut. Ge god service och vägledning till våra kunder Hantera och följa upp förändringar i låneengagemang samt säkerställa att arbetet utförs i enlighet med gällande regelverk, interna riktlinjer och processer. Vi söker dig som har: Har arbetat med privatlån, bolån eller andra krediter Har erfarenhet av service, administrativt arbete och arbete via telefon Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift Vi ser det som positivt om du har arbetat med pantbrev och säkerheter. För att trivas och prestera väl i rollen tror vi att du behöver vara: En lagspelare som är noggrann med öga för detaljer, du vet att det är just precisionen som gör skillnad och du trivs i en roll där ditt kvalitetsfokus får komma till sin fulla rätt. Du är analytisk och får energi av siffror; du har intresse för transaktionsflöden, gör avstämningar och har en känsla för när något behöver en extra titt. Du är även kundfokuserad och tycker om mötet med människor. Du är också strukturerad skapar du enkelt ordning och överblick över ditt arbete och trivs med administrativa arbetsuppgifter. Utöver detta är det viktigt för oss att du känner igen dig i våra värderingar: vi är helhjärtade, vi samarbetar och vi tar ledningen Praktisk information: Arbetstider: 8.30-17 Läs mer om de praktiska delarna längst ner i annonsen. headline: Gör din praktik på SvD
description_text: Vill du lära dig det bästa om det mesta för att bli en fullfjädrad journalist? Vill du lära dig av oss – och tror du att vi kan lära oss av dig? Skicka gärna in din ansökan till SvD, vi kommer att ta in flera praktikanter under våren 2027. Vi drivs av att utveckla våra medarbetare och av att se nya talanger frodas. Många av våra journalister började sina karriärer som praktikanter hos oss. Nu letar vi efter fler blivande stjärnor. På SvD kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med kunniga, prestigelösa och engagerade kollegor i en organisation där du ges möjlighet att bli ditt bästa jag. Vi har erfarna, drivna och vänliga chefer som uppmuntrar till utveckling. Vassa armbågar ger vi inte mycket för – på SvD arbetar vi tillsammans. Vem är du? Vi tror att du är en idérik person som vill vara med och göra nyfiken och framåtlutad journalistik. Du drivs av nyfikenhet och tycker om att få nya insikter. Om du dessutom, med dina intressen, din bakgrund och dina erfarenheter, tillför fler perspektiv i vår journalistik är det meriterande. Kanske använder du Tiktok som sökmotor eller är aktiv i föreningslivet? Eller så har du erfarenheter från andra kulturer och/eller goda språkkunskaper i exempelvis arabiska, kurdiska, ukrainska, turkiska, persiska, somali, ryska, tigrinja, bosniska, kroatiska eller serbiska. Vår redaktion är indelad i olika nav, redaktionella enheter som i sin tur består av flera mindre team. Nedan kan du läsa mer om några av dem. Koll: Om du gillar att jobba med breaking news och dagens viktigaste nyhetsämnen är det här navet för dig. Du är engagerad, samarbetsvillig och kreativ. Du jobbar strukturerat, vilket gör att du är effektiv och snabb i ditt arbete. Här finns möjlighet att praktisera som onlinespecialist – en roll där du skriver korta nyheter, liverapporterar, publicerar färdiga artikelpaket och redaktörar andra onlinespecialisters texter. För frågor, kontakta Petter Forslund . Fokus: Vill du ta dig an de riktigt stora nyheterna, de som sätter samhället och världen i rörelse? I Fokusnavet samsas team som politik, tech, pengar och utrikes, och här finns möjlighet att praktisera som reporter i ett eller flera av dessa. För frågor, kontakta Claes Lönegård . Ljud: Vänd dig till Mattias Wikdahl om du vill ställa frågor om ljudberättande. Livet: Vi vet att våra läsare vill få insikt, utvecklas och bli guidade till ett bättre liv, oavsett om det handlar om vetenskap, hälsa, mat eller dryck. Här gör vi just den typen av journalistik, med möjlighet att praktisera som reporter. För frågor, kontakta Joanna Drevinger . eSvD och print: Du gillar att ha koll på nyhetsläget, tar egna initiativ och kan arbeta i högt tempo när så krävs. Du trivs i rollen som tidningsmakare och har goda språkkunskaper samt känsla för form. I vårt team arbetar redaktörer med presentation av allt material som ingår i en modern morgontidning – från sportresultat till utrikesanalyser. Tillsammans med dem får du skapa tidningar i såväl print som digital form. För frågor, kontakta Jenny Danielsson . Sociala medier: Vill du klippa video, skriva manus och stå framför kameran? Kan du förklara komplicerade nyheter och fenomen enkelt och tydligt? Gör du din praktik hos SoMe-teamet får du bidra till att visa upp Svenska Dagbladets journalistik på smarta och roliga sätt i SvD:s sociala medier. För frågor, kontakta Matilda Lundberg . För att göra din praktik hos oss är det viktigt att du har praktik via en journalistutbildning och att praktikperioden är minst tio veckor lång. Sista ansökningsdag är den 23 oktober och vi jobbar med löpande urval. Ange hur många veckor du är intresserad av och vilken eller vilka roller och nav som väcker ditt intresse. Det finns möjlighet att pröva på olika roller under praktiken på SvD. Kultur, ljudberättande samt eSvD och print tar dock enbart emot praktikanter som är där under hela eller större delen av sin praktikperiod. För generella frågor om praktik eller ansökan, kontakta redaktionschef Viktor Ander via mejl . Välkommen med din ansökan!

It's a role with real weight – and a rare opportunity to leave your mark on how we underwrite credit for the future. We are the team behind every credit decision made across our markets. Our team includes lead analysts in each market and a broader analytics group of junior and senior analysts and scorecard developers. We're currently rewiring how we work, exploring new technologies to strengthen our underwriting. About the role As Head of Credit Underwriting and Decision Analytics, you'll lead the team responsible for our credit process design and performance, working across pricing, risk and compliance. You'll be a key voice among senior stakeholders, driving the direction of underwriting in a complex, ever-changing environment. Your main responsibilities include: Designing, developing and optimizing the credit process across all credit facilities Balancing pricing, risk, compliance and technical perspectives in every decision Leading and developing lead analysts and a broader analytics team Collaborating with senior stakeholders across the business to align priorities Driving new ways of working, including new technologies and analytical tools Who we're looking for We're looking for someone analytical who thrives on solving complex problems and cutting through ambiguity. You build strong relationships and listen closely to understand different perspectives, and you're motivated by high-impact work where you help your team find novel ways forward. On top of this, we're looking for someone who: Holds an M.Sc. or equivalent degree from a demanding field Has experience in banking, quantitative analysis and driving initiatives in complex stakeholder environments Brings deep knowledge of consumer credit and comfort operating in ambiguity Has university-level skills in mathematics and strong analytical judgment Communicates clearly and succinctly across technical and senior audiences Speaks English fluently; Swedish and/or Norwegian is a plus Brings a senior level of experience, ready to lead a specialized team Have you heard of NOBAVERSE? In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly ! ✨ Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page. headline: DevOps Engineer within eHealth
description_text: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. The position We are looking for a DevOps Engineer who wants to play an active role in how we build, deploy, operate and continuously improve products within Cambio’s Social Care portfolio. You will work with both modern SaaS and container-based solutions as well as established products used in our customers’ daily operations. Your focus will be on automation, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and operational reliability across different delivery models. This is a hands-on role where you will combine technical implementation with collaboration across teams, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders. You will help modernize our delivery processes and influence how DevOps and platform capabilities evolve within Social Care. Some of the things you’ll do · Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated release processes. · Develop and operate container-based environments using Kubernetes or OpenShift. · Improve deployment processes through automation and Infrastructure as Code. · Strengthen monitoring, observability and operational reliability. · Work closely with developers, architects, support and operations. · Engage with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to understand needs and improve delivery models. · Contribute to the modernization of existing products and services towards more scalable and automated delivery models. We offer At Cambio, you do not just work with technology. You help build solutions that support important work in health and social care. You will be part of modernizing an established product portfolio, deepen your skills in DevOps, automation and containerization, and grow through increased responsibility, ownership and technical challenges. At Cambio, we encourage initiative, continuous learning and knowledge sharing. Our culture is built on Trust, Care and Together. About you You have a few years of experience within DevOps, infrastructure, operations, platform engineering or software delivery and are looking for a role where you can take greater ownership while continuing to grow professionally. You are curious, proactive and enjoy solving problems. You take initiative, learn independently and find practical ways forward, especially in environments where not everything is fully defined. We believe you have experience with some of the following · DevOps, infrastructure, operations or platform engineering. · Scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python or similar. · CI/CD pipelines and software delivery automation. · Containers and orchestration platforms such as Docker, Kubernetes or similar. · Infrastructure automation or Infrastructure as Code. · Monitoring, logging and observability. · SQL databases. · Swedish and English, verbally as well as in writing Just as important as specific technologies is your ability to learn, take ownership and continuously improve how systems are built, deployed and operated. Place of employment : Linköping or Motala. Scope : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link. We look forward to receiving your application! CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life . Read more about us here! A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible - explore our employee benefits Learn more about our recruitment process here Are you interested in Cambio but you don’t feel that this position is the perfect match? Check out our other open positions at our career site.

headline: Sales Associate
description_text: Vi söker en engagerad Sales Associate till Resurs Brinner du för att hjälpa människor, älskar kundkontakt och drivs av tydliga mål? Då kan detta vara din nästa karriärmöjlighet! Som Sales Associate på Resurs blir du en viktig del i vårt ambitiösa team, där vi ständigt motiverar och utmanar varandra för att nå resultat tillsammans. Om rollen I rollen som Sales Associate hjälper du våra kunder till en tryggare och smartare privatekonomi. Genom både utgående samtal till befintliga kunder och inkommande ärenden via telefon och webb, kartlägger du kundernas behov och erbjuder lösningar som gör skillnad. Med en bred produktportfölj – som samlingslån, betalförsäkringar, kreditkort och sparkonton – guidar du kunderna rätt, samtidigt som du bygger långsiktiga relationer och bidrar till teamets gemensamma framgång. Dina arbetsuppgifter: Kartlägga kunders behov och erbjuda skräddarsydda lösningar Arbeta med ett brett produktutbud inom lån, försäkringar, kreditkort och sparande Bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och skapa trygghet genom hela kundresan Driva din egen försäljning och arbeta målinriktat för att nå KPI:er och försäljningsmål Delta i daglig coaching, pulsmöten och bidra till teamets energi och resultat Vi tror att du har: Förmåga att skapa förtroende och bygga relationer via telefon och digitala kanaler Struktur i ditt administrativa arbete och förmåga att hålla ordning även under intensiva perioder En målfokuserad och lösningsorienterad inställning, utan att tumma på kundupplevelsen Erfarenhet av försäljning är meriterande – men viktigast är din potential och vilja att utvecklas En positiv attityd som smittar av sig på både kunder och kollegor Vi söker dig som kombinerar driv, energi och en passion för kundservice. Du är en god kommunikatör, trivs i en snabbföränderlig miljö och vill utvecklas inom försäljning. Krav för rollen: Gymnasieexamen eller motsvarande 2-5 års relevant erfarenhet av försäljning och kundrådgivning Varför välja Resurs? Hos oss på Resurs är du mer än bara en säljare – du är en viktig del av vår resa framåt. Vi erbjuder en modern arbetsplats i fräscha lokaler på vårt huvudkontor på Väla, Helsingborg. Vi har trygga anställningsvillkor och kollektivavtal, och alla anställda omfattas av förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag, massage, subventionerad lunch m.m. Ansök genom att skicka in ditt CV och en video – enkelt och personligt. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning. Annonsen är tillgänglig till 31 oktober. Viktigt att känna till: På slutkandidater genomför vi en utförlig bakgrundskontroll via ett externt bolag.

headline: Senior Software Engineer to Customer Identity Platform
description_text: Join our Customer Identity Platform team, where we enable secure and compliant access to our banking services and make it easy for customers to identify themselves with confidence. We are now looking for a Senior Software engineer who thrives on complex challenges and wants to play a key role in building and scaling our AML/KYC (Anti-Money Laundering / Know Your Customer) platform. Get an idea of the role 🚀 Be part of an agile team that values accelerated development, quality, fast feedback, and continuous improvement ☁️ Design, build, and optimize scalable APIs using modern AWS services and cloud-native technologies 🤖 Extensive daily use of AI-assisted coding tools (e.g. Claude code, Cursor, Copilot) for accelerated delivery and evaluating correctness and security before shipping. 💻 Extensive knowledge in backend development, using Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, Postgres db / Mongodb, Kafka, GitHub, Elastic and AWS 🔗 Understand and work with data lineage, data lake and data pipeline orchestration tools like Dagster. 🏗️ Contribute to architectural solutions and can describe complex features and/or systems in detail and are able to communicate technical information effectively (written and verbal). 🤝 Collaborate with product owners, architects and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements and deliver secure and compliant services On a personal level You are passionate about building robust, scalable, and secure systems. You're also excited about being part of a team with a real impact on customer trust and safety. Requirements for the role: ✓Senior Software Engineer with solid experience shipping to production. ✓ Comfortable working in a complex, fast-moving area where the right answer is not known yet. ✓ Are a team player who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives ✓ Understand secure system design and data protection ✓ Can explain technical work clearly to non-engineers and pair productively with engineers across teams. ✓ Advocate best practices in engineering and observability. Resurs in brief At Resurs, we make everyday finances easier through innovative and customer-focused solutions. With customers across the Nordics and more than 800 colleagues, we are committed to creating long-term value for individuals, businesses, and society. Recognized as a career company for the past six years, we put strong emphasis on both personal and professional growth. We want to make a difference by striving to be our best, acting with kindness, and building trust through clarity and collaboration. Our heart beats strong and it shows in everything we do. Although we are based in the Nordics, our team is enriched by the breadth of perspectives brought by colleagues from different countries. We foster a welcoming and supportive culture, where collaboration drives us to achieve the best outcomes for our users. Apply today! Don’t wait to send in your application. Selection and interviews take place on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the last application date. We look forward to hearing from you! headline: Data Engineer in Data Product Engineering
description_text: If you choose to apply, please read the job ad in full and include a short cover letter. We are most interested in hearing from the real you, so we encourage authentic applications written in your own words. The opportunity in a nutshell Interested in combining hands-on data engineering with close collaboration across the business? This role could be a good fit for someone with 4+ years of experience who enjoys building reliable data products and working with others to make them useful. Role : Join as a Data Engineer in our Data Product Engineering team within Schibsted's Data & AI organization, where we build reliable, well-governed, and scalable data products used across Finance, HR, Product, Subscription, and other parts of the business. Core tools and practices : Our everyday toolkit includes SQL and Python as core languages, together with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, AWS, Terraform, and Git, supported by solid engineering practices around testing, documentation, CI/CD, and version control. Company : Schibsted is home to some of the most established and widely used media brands in the Nordics, including Aftenposten, VG, Svenska Dagbladet, Aftonbladet, E24, Bergens Tidende, and Stavanger Aftenblad. Across our broader Data & AI focus, data, analytics, and AI help us build better products, support smarter decisions, and create value across those newsrooms and businesses. Location : This role is based in Oslo or Stockholm. We work in a hybrid setup, which means this is not a fully remote role, and candidates need to reside in Sweden or Norway and be able to work from one of our offices at least 2 days a week. Why this role : You will join a relatively new team with room to contribute, learn, and help shape how we work as we continue to build trusted data products across Schibsted. Sounds like your kind of role? Read on Who are you? We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in data engineering who is also excited by the opportunity to keep learning, deepen their craft, and grow together with the team. You have around 4+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related role, with a track record of building reliable data solutions in production environments. Strong SQL skills are important, along with a solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and how to design data products that are useful, trustworthy, and maintainable. You can write and debug SQL and Python yourself at a strong professional level. AI-assisted tools are welcome, but this role requires solid enough fundamentals to solve everyday engineering problems without depending totally on them. On the Python side, we are looking for good software engineering fundamentals, including the ability to structure maintainable applications and apply object-oriented design principles where appropriate. You have hands-on experience with dbt in production environments and solid working knowledge of the wider toolkit we use, including Airflow, Snowflake, AWS, Terraform, Git, and Python and / or similar tools. You will likely enjoy this role if you are comfortable making pragmatic technical decisions in environments where requirements evolve and not everything is fully defined upfront. You care about engineering quality and can contribute to practices around testing, documentation, observability, governance, and cost-efficient pipeline design. Clear communication matters just as much as technical strength. We value people who can work well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders , explain tradeoffs clearly, and contribute positively to team collaboration and knowledge sharing. What's the job like? As a Data Engineer , your job is to help us build data as a product, not just pipelines that move data from one place to another. You will create robust data models, improve the reliability and scalability of our pipelines, and help shape the engineering practices that make our data products trusted and reusable across Schibsted Media. What you will be expected to do Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into pragmatic, well-scoped data solutions. Design, build, and maintain reliable pipelines and transformations in Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Python. Develop scalable data models that support analytics, reporting, and future AI use cases. Improve technical quality through testing, documentation, monitoring, and maintainable engineering practices. Contribute to good architectural and implementation decisions across the team. Contribute through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing within the team. Work closely with adjacent platform and Data & AI teams to align on standards, dependencies, and shared ways of working. What success looks like Success in this role means growing into a confident contributor who understands our data landscape, ways of working, and stakeholder needs. Over time, that includes contributing across a mix of smaller support tasks through our weekly rotation as well as larger pieces of work , helping build reliable pipelines and data models, and developing the judgment to deliver pragmatic solutions together with the team. Depending on your experience and the needs of the work, that can mean contributing as part of a team or taking the lead on a project . Why join us? You will join a team that is still shaping its ways of working , which means there is real room to contribute, learn, and grow. You will work on data products with visible impact across Schibsted , supporting both technical and non-technical users in domains such as Product, Subscription, Finance, and HR. You will be part of a company whose work matters in everyday life across the Nordics , helping support trusted media brands through better data, analytics, and AI capabilities. You will work in an international environment with strong trust, autonomy, and good opportunities for learning through engineering communities and collaboration across Data & AI. You will join a team that enjoys solving challenging problems, wants to build high-quality data products, and cares about the people they work with. Got your attention? Let us hear from you! The application period closes on 28 September 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

headline: Spontanansökan, Aftonbladet
description_text: Vill du jobba med oss på Sveriges största nyhetssajt? Vi söker medarbetare redan i höst! Varje dag ger vi läsare, tittare och lyssnare senaste nytt inom nyheter, nöje sport och feature. Vi granskar makten, utmanar de styrande och avslöjar missförhållanden. Dessutom både informerar vi och underhåller. Vi är alltid intresserade av att komma i kontakt med nya kollegor då vi kontinuerligt är i behov av inhoppare och vikarier. Välkommen att skicka in en spontanansökan! Några av våra avdelningar: Breaking news: Vad är det som har hänt? Flera miljoner svenskar vänder sig till Aftonbladet varje dag för att få svar på den frågan. Aftonbladet skapade en stark breakingdesk 2015 och vi har inte haft en lugn stund sedan dess. Nu är vi Sveriges största och roligaste nyhetsdesk och söker dig med dokumenterad erfarenhet av sådant som liverapportering, omvärldsbevakning och snabb nyhetsvärdering. Vi söker både reportrar och onlineredaktörer. Sportbladet: Sportbladet startades 8 maj 2000 och är idag Sveriges största sportdestination med ca 1,5 miljoner läsare varje dag – dygnet runt. Den rosa redaktionen har lyft svensk sportjournalistik till en helt ny nivå genom åren. Sportbladet finns digitalt, som daglig sportbilaga, poddar, tv-format och sportbiblar. Redaktionen bevakar all världens idrott med fokus på fotboll, hockey, vinteridrott och mästerskap och har blivit prisad för sin journalistik och innovation vid ett flertal tillfällen. Vi söker både skrivande reportrar, redaktörer och tv-medarbetare. Video: Aftonbladets livesändningar och nyhetsinslag når miljoner svenskar varje dag. Ett ansvar vi tar på största allvar och som tvingar oss att ständigt förnyas. Vi livebevakar de största händelserna, förklarar de svåraste skeenderna med grafiska inslag och fördjupar Aftonbladets berättande med videojournalistik. Vi arbetar i små team där alla har en viktig roll såväl i breakinglägen som planerad produktion. Sociala medier: Som sociala medier-specialist på Aftonbladet kommer du att jobba med att optimera, skapa och publicera innehåll i alla de olika kanaler där vi på Aftonbladet är aktiva – Instagram, Facebook, Youtube och Tiktok. Tillsammans med resten av redaktionen kommer du även att utforma och testa nya format på de olika sociala medier-plattformarna för att sprida Aftonbladets journalistik och engagera vår publik. Radio: Den 17 augusti startade Aftonbladet Sveriges första kommersiella och rikstäckande aktualitetsradiokanal, Aftonbladet Radio. Som nyhetsinsittare hittar, värderar och berättar du nyheter – snabbt, träffsäkert och med rätt ton. I rollen tar du fram nyheter till våra radiosändningar och läser upp dem. Det är en roll för dig som gillar puls, ansvar och att vara mitt i nyhetsflödet när det händer och erfarenhet av breakingjournalistik är meriterande. Som researcher ligger du steget före i nyhetsflödet, tar fram fakta, vinklar och relevanta perspektiv och säkerställer att programledarna har rätt underlag, i rätt tid. När tempot ökar behåller du lugnet och prioriterar klokt. Du planerar sändningen, bokar gäster, hittar röster som berör och ser till att lyssnarnas perspektiv får plats i programmet. Nöjet: Aftonbladet Nöje är Skandinaviens största förmedlare av nöjesnyheter. Dagligen engagerar och informerar vi miljoner läsare med de största nyheterna och snackisarna kring tv, musik, film och kändisliv. Våra läsare älskar mixen av tunga avslöjanden och lättare kortisar och vi brinner för den. Det hoppas vi att du som söker dig till Nöjesbladet också gör. Vad vi kan erbjuda? • En stimulerande arbetsplats där du når en miljonpublik. • Kunniga, smarta och drivna kollegor och en trevlig arbetsmiljö • Krävande och erfarna chefer som får dig att utvecklas varje dag. • Engagerad publik som hjälper oss att bli bättre. Välkommen med din ansökan!

headline: Credit Risk Analyst, Danish Portfolio

headline: Application Security Engineer
description_text: Help protect the technology behind some of the Nordics' most important news organisations. At Schibsted, cybersecurity is about more than protecting systems and applications. It's also about protecting journalism, the people behind it, and the technology that makes independent news accessible to millions of people. We're looking for an Application Security Engineer to join our cybersecurity team in Stockholm or Oslo. This is a great opportunity for someone at the beginning of their cybersecurity career who wants to develop their technical skills, gain experience across a wide range of security challenges, and work closely with developers to build safer products. First, a little about us Schibsted is one of the leading media groups in the Nordics, home to well-known news brands including Aftonbladet, Svenska Dagbladet, VG and Aftenposten. Every day, millions of people turn to our news organisations to stay informed, understand the world around them, and access independent journalism. Behind these brands is a large and diverse technology organisation, building and maintaining the digital products, platforms and infrastructure that make all of this possible. And with that comes an interesting security challenge. Our news brands are highly visible, and the threats we face go beyond those of a typical corporate environment. From protecting applications and user data to safeguarding journalists and ensuring uninterrupted access to news, cybersecurity plays an important role in keeping our journalism accessible and independent. That's where you come in. What you'll be working on As an Application Security Engineer, you'll help strengthen the security of our applications and digital products across Schibsted. You'll be part of a cybersecurity team working across Sweden and Norway, collaborating with developers, architects and engineering teams throughout the organisation. A big part of your job will be identifying vulnerabilities and security risks. But finding an issue is only the beginning. You'll also work with the teams responsible for our products to understand the problem, find practical solutions, and help make sure vulnerabilities actually get resolved. Since Schibsted is a large organisation with many different brands, products and technologies, no two challenges will necessarily look the same. You'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, explore different technologies and gradually take on more responsibility as you develop your skills. Some of the things you'll do: Help identify and assess security vulnerabilities in our applications and digital products. Work directly with developers and engineering teams to understand and remediate security issues. Participate in security assessments and help integrate security practices throughout the software development lifecycle. Support teams in understanding security risks and finding practical solutions. Work with application security tools and contribute to improving our processes and ways of working. Share knowledge and collaborate with colleagues across the organisation to strengthen security awareness. Contribute to building a stronger security culture where security becomes a natural part of how we develop products. Who we're looking for You might be at the beginning of your cybersecurity career, with some hands-on experience in application security, penetration testing or a related technical field. Perhaps you've recently graduated, worked in your first security role, or developed your skills through technical projects. What matters most to us is your technical curiosity, your willingness to learn, and your interest in understanding how applications can be made more secure. We'd love to hear from you if you have: Some practical experience with application security, penetration testing or related security work, whether through employment, internships or personal projects. An understanding of common application vulnerabilities, such as those covered by the OWASP Top 10, and how they can be mitigated. Familiarity with application security testing tools, such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP or similar. A basic understanding of modern software development practices, web technologies and how applications are built. An interest in assessing security risks and finding practical ways to address them. The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and an interest in collaborating with developers and other teams. Experience with cloud environments, infrastructure security, threat modelling or secure software development is also valuable, but not a requirement. We're not expecting you to know everything from day one. We're looking for someone who's proactive, collaborative and eager to develop their skills. Someone who doesn't just want to identify security problems, but enjoys working with others to solve them. Why join us? Work that matters. The technology you help protect supports independent journalism and news organisations that play an important role in society. Interesting security challenges. You'll work across a diverse technology landscape, with different products, engineering teams and security needs. An opportunity to grow. You'll have the chance to learn from experienced cybersecurity colleagues, develop your technical expertise and gain hands-on experience with security challenges across a large technology organisation. A role that combines technology and people. You'll get to dive into technical security challenges while building relationships and helping teams improve how they work. Room to make an impact. Even early in your career, you'll have the opportunity to contribute not only to individual security improvements, but also to how we approach application security across Schibsted. If this sounds like the kind of challenge you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

För att söka denna tjänst behöver du ha fyllt 18 år och behärska svenska i både tal och skrift. Det är även meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av kundkontakt, exempelvis inom kundservice eller försäljning, antingen över telefon eller i butik. Har du dessutom grundläggande kunskaper i säljteknik ser vi det som ett stort plus. Så kommer du göra skillnad hos oss Som butikssäljare befinner du dig i hjärtat av vår verksamhet – i kundmötet. Att öppna dörrarna till butiken, innebär att komma rakt in i pulsen. Det är här vi hjälper våra kunder att få ett bättre abonnemang, den senaste hårdvaran eller att fixa fakturastrulet. Det handlar helt enkelt om att få bort vardagens störningsmoment så att våra kunder kan fokusera på det viktiga i livet. Ge kundservice i världsklass: Du möter kunderna där de är, och skapa en upplevelse som överträffar förväntningarna. Rådgivning: Genom att kombinera produktkunskap och lyhördhet guidar du kunden till rätt lösningar. Bidra till kampanjer och aktiviteter: Du håller dig uppdaterad om aktuella erbjudanden och bidrar till en trivsam och engagerande butiksmiljö för alla besökare. Hålla butiken i toppskick : I nära samarbete med teamet säkerställer du en trivsam, välorganiserad och inbjudande butiksmiljö. Våra löften till dig Vi är bättre tillsammans . Hos oss möts du av en familjär och inkluderande kultur, en stark gemensam värdegrund och ett ledarskap som ger dig frihet och handlingskraft. Vi tror på att ge varandra förtroende och frihet att agera och fatta beslut, samtidigt som vi är där för varandra i med- och motgångar. Vi stöttar relationer och samhällen . Telenor är ett samhällsbärande företag och här får ditt arbete ett större syfte. Vi skapar värde för miljoner människor varje dag och har ett kundnära förhållningssätt där mänskliga relationer står i centrum. Vi ger plats för livet . Vi finns där genom livets alla faser och erbjuder trygghetspaket i form av bl.a. kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet att skräddarsy försäkringslösningar som passar just dig, för ditt behov här och nu. Som tillsvidareanställd har du dessutom vår förmån "två give-me-a-break-days" per år som ger dig en extra paus med möjlighet till återhämtning och välmående. Vi bjuder in till en spännande karriärresa . Din utveckling står i centrum och hos oss är lärande en del av kulturen. I butikerna fokuserar vi på att coacha, utveckla och ge dig rätt verktyg för att trivas och växa. Telenor erbjuder både fysiska och digitala utbildningar anpassade för just din utvecklingsresa. Genom Växa, vår utbildningsplattform, och andra lärandeinitiativ får du därmed möjligheten att utvecklas och forma din egen karriär. Majoriteten av våra tjänster tillsätts internt så när du vill vidare väntar möjligheterna här. Sök till oss idag Vill du ta ditt nästa steg i karriären med oss? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Vi träffar kandidater löpande så hör av dig redan idag. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via mejl. Bra att känna till Om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du få göra tre tester som fokuserar på din personlighet och färdigheter. Enligt Telenors policy genomför vi även bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat i samtliga rekryteringar.

headline: EDD Analyst
description_text: Get an idea of the role We are developing our Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) function and are looking for an EDD Analyst to contribute across its full scope. You communicate complex findings clearly, both in writing and in conversation, and you bring a collaborative mindset to everything you do. headline: Senior Data Engineer
description_text: Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others. As one of the world’s leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. We’re at the forefront of digital storytelling, driven by a vision to make the world a more empathetic and creative place. Ready for your next chapter? We are now on the lookout for a platform-focused Senior Data Engineer to join the team in Stockholm. About the Team The Data Engineering team is responsible for empowering Storytel with data. We drive the full data lifecycle, from ingestion to delivery, and help ensure that the rest of the business have the data, tools and engineering collaboration needed to help make informed data-driven decisions. As a team, we provide cross-functional competencies in data engineering as well as analytics engineering to the rest of Storytel. Some of the tech stack and tools we work with are dbt (SQL), Looker, BigQuery, Python, Airflow, Terraform, CI/CD, Github, Airbyte as well as other products included within the Google Cloud Platform. Moreover, we like to keep our skills up to date by frequently engaging lab days. About the Role As a Data Engineer, your main responsibility will be to enable the team and the rest of the organization with a data platform and the tools that power data at Storytel. You will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with plenty of opportunities to experiment with new technologies and solutions. Our team is highly collaborative and works in a cross-functional organizational landscape with the following: Example of responsibilities Build core infrastructure: Contribute to building a large-scale, highly performant self-service data platform using cutting-edge technologies Innovate and improve: Drive internal tooling and process development to continuously increase data quality and constantly improve the engineering experience. Excellence in data management: Continuously improve on building capabilities for effective data utilization across Storytel. Collaboration: Collaborate with other engineers, data analysts, data scientists, and decision-makers to understand needs and build self-service. About you To be a fit for our team, we believe that you: Have a few years of hands-on experience in delivering data products and know the value of accurate consistent data infrastructure. Have experience in delivering infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Github (Github actions), and maintaining data orchestration tools such as Airflow, dbt, Airbyte. Have experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and data warehousing (preferably BigQuery). Have a good understanding of data access, storage, and optimization. Are able to break down and explain complicated technical solutions independent of stakeholders. Thrive in an environment focusing on innovation and collaboration and continuously work on personal development. Bonus qualifications: Experience with streaming data ingestion. Expertise in developing CI/CD pipelines tailored for data infrastructure. Join a world of stories At Storytel, we’re a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us. Does this sound like your next story? Simply fill out the application form and share your CV or LinkedIn profile – no cover letter needed. Answer a few questions, and you’re all set.

headline: Cloud Engineer
description_text: We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer who enjoys working in the space where developers and infrastructure meet. Here, you’ll spend your time automating the mundane, architecting the complex, and scaling the future of our Azure AI and OpenAI offerings. This role is for you if you find more joy in writing a PowerShell script to solve a recurring app error than in managing a cluster’s networking. This is a code-centric role where infrastructure is treated as a software product. Everything you build is versioned, reviewed, tested, and continuously improved. Our goal is to reduce repetitive work and create the “Golden Paths” that let developers and AI teams deploy quickly, securely, and reliably. About the role: As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll help build and grow our Azure-based platform. You’ll own the design, automation, and delivery of modular cloud infrastructure, ensuring it’s resilient, scalable, and easy for teams to use. Your work will reduce friction, remove unnecessary steps, and make it simple for developers and data teams to focus on building features instead of worrying about infrastructure. What you’ll do: Build the "Golden Path" Pipelines: You won't just "run" pipelines; you will architect them. You’ll design and maintain CI/CD templates (YAML-based) that standardize how our applications are built, tested, and deployed. Your goal is to make the path from code-complete to production-ready as invisible and frictionless as possible for our developers. Automated Application Remediation: We don't believe in manual maintenance. You will use PowerShell and Azure DevOps to build automated pipelines for things like patching the container OS, reporting on deviations and self healing infrastructure Infrastructure as Versioned Code: You’ll design and implement modular Azure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), following the Azure Well-Architected Framework for reliability, performance, and cost. We are looking for you who have: Expert-level PowerShell skills : We operate in an environment where automation is built on PowerShell first. (Bash & Python are secondary) Proven experience with Azure Bicep: You should be comfortable treating infrastructure as a software product, versioning, testing and modularizing Bicep code. Developer-centric approach: You don't need to be a fullstack developer, but you need to understand application logic enough to automate patching, troubleshoot database connections, and optimize application performance within the cloud. Fluency in English (written and spoken). You’ll be comfortable owning tasks end to end and making technical decisions independently within the areas listed above. Ideally, you have some years of hands-on experience with Azure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines, but we care more about what you can do and that you enjoy the field, rather than the exact number of years. It's positive if you have: Active Azure certifications such as AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer), AZ-305 (Solutions Architect), AZ-204 (Developer Associate) Experience from regulated or security-conscious environments is a plus In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead. Read more about NOBA Benefits here: https://careers.noba.bank/pages/information Have you heard of NOBAVERSE? In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity.
